ai.group_prepare: 1. Prepare a task for an AI agent
ai.prepare_help: The program creates a folder with the entries to check, instructions (INSTRUCTIONS.md), a glossary of names and a check script. Point an AI agent (e.g. Claude Code) to this folder – it saves its corrections in the results/ subfolder.
ai.continue_tip:
Find an existing task in the AI tasks folder and prepare a prompt
so a new AI agent continues where the previous one stopped.
ai.prompt_label: Prompt to paste into the AI agent:
ai.import_help: Corrections are added to the project as suggestions (blue rows, “AI” filter). You can accept, reject or edit each one.

ai.no_entries: No entry matches the selected criteria.

Use “Generate task” to create the first one.

install.help:
Writes your corrections into the game files. Close the game before installing.
Before the first change the program saves a copy of the original files, and before every later change a copy of the current state (folder {folder}). A Steam game update may overwrite the changes – just install them again.

Make sure the game is closed. Continue?

Continue?

voice.help: Links every dialogue line to the spoken voice-over of the game, so you can listen to it in tab 2 and the program can check whether the subtitle fits the speech (length, reading speed). Playing needs vgmstream-cli, which decodes the game's Wwise audio.
voice.index_missing: No voice index yet – build it once (about half a minute).
stt.help: Writes down what the voice actor actually says and compares it with the original subtitle. Lines where they differ get 🔊, and the AI task then contains what is really spoken. Runs locally on the CPU (about 1–2 s per line with base.en on a Steam Deck); you can stop and continue at any time.
stt.scope.missing_file: current file – only lines without a transcript
stt.scope.missing_edited: all files – only my edited lines without a transcript
stt.scope.missing_all: all files – every line without a transcript (many hours)
stt.missing: Speech recognition needs the faster-whisper package: .venv/bin/pip install faster-whisper
stt.status: Transcribed lines: {n}, subtitle differs from the voice: {bad}.
terms.help: Finds names of characters, places, items and skills that are translated in different ways, and lines whose original mentions a name the translation doesn't use. Double-click an entry to open it.
update.changed: The game was updated since the last export. Refresh the texts: your corrections are kept, corrections whose original line changed are marked ⟳, and then install them again in tab 4.
update.same: The game texts haven't changed since the last export.
update.ask: The game was updated since this project was exported. Refresh the texts from the game now? Your corrections are kept.
update.done: Texts refreshed. Corrections to check because the original changed (⟳): {n}. Install the changes again in tab 4.

api.group: Run the task through an API
api.help: Instead of an AI agent, the program can send the latest task (or the one opened with “Continue work”) part by part straight to a model. Results are checked and saved in results/, then load them below as usual. Works with Claude, any OpenAI-compatible service, and local models in Ollama (URL http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions, no key). API use is billed by the provider.
api.remember_tip: Saved as plain text in translator_config.json – don't share that file.
api.model_hint: model name, e.g. from your provider
api.missing: Enter the model name and an API key (not needed for a local URL).

api.finished: API run finished: {parts} parts, {n} corrections, {bad} invalid lines dropped. Load the results with the button below.
patch.help: A patch is a small file with only your corrected lines. Players install it into their own copy of the game (here or with apply_patch), other translators import it as suggestions. Lines whose original changed in a game update are skipped automatically.
